lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The Spreadsheet Dimension. Everything that happens in Glimmerdale... is calculated HERE first. We are inside the math, hero.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: Are WE in a cell somewhere?

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: Row 7, column YOU. I checked. Your formula is beautiful. Don't let anyone edit it.

lines.speaker: Pivot Dragon
lines.text: I HAVE SUMMARIZED YOUR PARTY BY ELEMENT. WOULD YOU LIKE TO SEE YOURSELVES... AS PERCENTAGES?

lines.speaker: Pivot Dragon
lines.text: DRAGGING YOU TO THE VALUES SECTION ANYWAY.
The center of the grid. A formula older than counting glows in the bar above the world.

lines.speaker: The First Formula
lines.text: =SUM(EVERYTHING). I HAVE BEEN CALCULATING THE FINAL TOTAL SINCE TIME BEGAN. YOU ARE A ROUNDING ERROR.

lines.speaker: The First Formula
lines.text: CALCULATION... COMPLETE. THE FINAL TOTAL IS... FRIENDSHIP?? CHECKING MY REFERENCES—

lines.speaker: Pip
lines.text: The math has spoken, hero, and honestly? I did NOT expect the math to be a coward about it.

lines.speaker: Hero
lines.text: One chapter left. Whoever runs ALL of this... is expecting us.
